label: readout-voltage functional, defined before any evaluation; no value computed in this record

registered_basis.coordinate: node R1 = the coupling-pad flux, per coupling-definition.md section 2 ('single-mode representation of a distributed resonator at its coupling node')
registered_basis.reference_conductor: the chip ground plane: the z = 0 PEC sheet outside the etch regions, continuous with the package floor (sheet_pec, physical 4, with outer_pec 2)
registered_basis.F_port_convention: from ground (−Y side) to the island (+Y side); V_port = V_F1 − V_ground

geometry_mm.frame: centre of the top surface of the chip substrate (spec §7.3); +X/+Y chip plane, +Z from chip toward lid

readout_functional.definition: V_R = (1/w_R) * integral over Gamma_R of E . l_hat dS, evaluated on the eigenmode field E of mode m; Palace's own lumped-port rule (lumpedportoperator.cpp InitializeLinearForms: V = 1/w * int E.l dS for rectangular ports) applied to a surface that carries no element

Gamma_R_plusY.meaning: from the ground plane at y = +0.080 to the pad edge at y = +0.050: V_R = V_pad - V_ground in the P_F1 sign convention

Gamma_R_minusY.meaning: from the ground plane at y = -0.080 to the pad edge at y = -0.050; the mirror surface, kept as the path-independence check

readout_functional.why_not_the_full_pad_edge: for x in [-0.505, -0.485] the island's etch (|y| <= 0.11499999999999999) removes the ground beyond y = +-0.08, so the pad-to-ground gap there is 0.065 mm, not 0.030 mm; the clean rectangle is the part of the edge that faces ground across the declared 0.030 mm
readout_functional.why_not_the_minus_X_side: the pad's -X side faces the F1 island across the 0.020 mm coupling gap, not the ground
readout_functional.why_not_the_plus_X_side: the pad's +X edge joins the CPW centre conductor (|y| <= 0.025) and otherwise faces the merged pad/slot etch, with no ground at a uniform distance
readout_functional.why_not_the_declared_P_R1_tap: P_R1 sits 0.150 mm from the shorted end (current antinode) and is a Route B excitation surface; the resonator's standing-wave profile there differs between modes, so a tap voltage is not the coupling-node coordinate
readout_functional.units: the exported field arrays are Palace's nondimensional E; V_nd = (1/lambda) (1/w_mm) int E_nd . l_hat dS_mm with lambda = Lc/L0 in mm; V [V] = sqrt(Z0) * V_nd; every factor cancels in rho_m = V_mR / V_mF

palace_dimensionalisation.source: palace/utils/iodata.cpp DimensionalizeValue (VOLTAGE: Hc*Z0*Lc with Hc = 1/sqrt(Z0 Lc^2)), NondimensionalizeInputs (Lc = largest bounding-box extent when Model.Lc is absent); postoperator.cpp WriteFields/ScaleGridFunctions (mesh written in input units, E coefficients rescaled so the exported values are the nondimensional field)

F_port_cross_check_recipe.target: port-V.csv Re{V[1]}, Im{V[1]} for m = 1, 2 of N1R and N2R (independent reconstruction reported by the user at ~2e-6 relative; to be reproduced, not fitted)
steps: open the boundary data collection (paraview/eigenmode_boundary) for the cycle of mode m; select cells with attribute 10 (port_F1)
for each triangle, int E.y dS = area * mean of the three per-element vertex values of E_real (and E_imag) . y_hat; the order-1 Nedelec field is linear in each element, so this is exact up to Float32
sum, divide by w = 0.020 mm and by lambda = 4.0, multiply by sqrt(Z0); compare Re and Im separately with port-V.csv

tangential continuity of the Nedelec space makes E.y_hat on the z = 0 face the same from either neighbouring element, so the side chosen by the boundary export (larger permittivity) does not matter for this integral
F_port_cross_check_recipe.expected_floor: Float32 on values (6e-8 relative) and on coordinates (about 3e-8 mm on 0.04 mm) gives an order-1e-6 relative floor, the size of the reported 2e-6

diagnostics_if_evaluated.rho_m: V_mR / V_mF, complex, same mode, global eigenvector phase cancels; Im(rho)/Re(rho) is the non-reality diagnostic
diagnostics_if_evaluated.r12: rho_1 / rho_2, complex; not replaced by its magnitude
diagnostics_if_evaluated.path_check: V_R(Gamma_R_plusY) vs V_R(Gamma_R_minusY): their difference bounds the Faraday path dependence and the mesh asymmetry
diagnostics_if_evaluated.mesh_check: N1R vs N2R: same base L2 mesh and identical readout-gap discretisation; the difference measures the port-box refinement's effect on the ratio, not readout-gap convergence
